name: Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals
summary: A brazier that summons a Fire Elemental under your control once a day.

stats.effect: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a {ref:glossary/magic} action to summon a **{ref:creature/fire-elemental}**. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {ref:glossary/initiative} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}. The brazier can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
